subject: External audit: vulnerability management cadence, SLAs, and CVE attestation
messages:
From: Evan Lee <evan.lee@evercrest.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: security.audit@evercrest.com
Date: Sat, 03 May 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: VM cadence & remediation evidence for SOC 2 audit

Hannah —

As part of Evercrest's internal SOC 2 readiness review (we're the external audit coordinator for the quarter), we need a compact evidence packet that shows Redwood's vulnerability management tempo and remediation commitments. Specifically we'd like:

- A brief statement of scanning cadence (authenticated/unauthenticated, frequency for infra vs app).
- The SLA you apply for triage and fix windows by severity (critical / high / medium).
- A recent scan index (last full authenticated scan + delta results).
- A signed attestation that Redwood will meet the stated SLAs for remediation and triage tied to CVE severity (this can be a one-page PDF).

Can you provide the items above by end-of-week? If it's easier, a shared Drive link to the index plus a single spreadsheet for CVE commitments works. Also let us know whether you can include the mapping to SOC 2 control CC6.x or the SIG/CAIQ section references — our auditors prefer the control mapping included.

If you need a template, we can share the auditor's attestation format (DocuSign-friendly).

Thanks — Evan
Evan Lee
Security Audit Lead, Evercrest Financial
security.audit@evercrest.com

---
Attachment requests: scan index (format: CSV), remediation commitments (XLSX), optional CAIQ mapping
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Evan Lee <evan.lee@evercrest.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 03 May 2025 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: VM cadence & remediation evidence for SOC 2 audit

Evan — thanks for the clear list. We can provide a compact package. A few clarifying items so we send precisely what the auditors want:

1) Do you want separate artifacts for application and infrastructure scans, or a single consolidated index?
2) For the attestation, should it be signed by someone on the security team (Monica) or by an exec (Ben) for the SOC 2 binder? Our standard practice is security-signed for tempo statements and executive-signed for contractual attestations.
3) Do you need the CAIQ mapping embedded in the same spreadsheet or as a separate document?

Monica will pull the scan index and CVE commitment matrix. We'll draft a one-page attestation and indicate the triage/remediation SLAs and exceptions. Planning to attach: vuln-scan-index-2025-05-02.csv and cve-commitment-matrix-2025-05-02.xlsx.

We'll aim to get the artifacts to you by Monday morning (PST). If you truly need them by EOW, we can expedite and send a preliminary packet tonight.

Hannah Schmitt
Director, Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference
---
(Quoted original request below)
> Hannah —
> 
> As part of Evercrest's internal SOC 2 readiness review ...
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Evan Lee <evan.lee@evercrest.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 04 May 2025 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Scan index and CVE commitment matrix — Redwood (initial packet)

Evan / Hannah / Ben —

Attaching the initial evidence requested. Summary highlights below (short excerpt from the attached spreadsheet):

- Scan cadence
  - External unauthenticated vulnerability scans: weekly (every 7 days).
  - Internal authenticated scans (full credentialed): monthly for infra and application fleets; critical services scanned daily with lightweight delta scanning.
  - Container image scanning integrated into CI: on every build & nightly full registry sweep.

- Triage & remediation SLAs (target windows from first triage to remediation or mitigation):
  - Critical (CVSS >= 9.0 or exploitable/active): 48-hour triage SLA; 7-calendar-day remediation target.
  - High (CVSS 7.0–8.9): 72-hour triage; 30-calendar-day remediation target (exceptions documented).
  - Medium/low: triaged within 14 days; remediation per release cadence / compensating control when applicable.

- Exceptions & compensating controls: documented exceptions are tracked in the spreadsheet; when a remediation window is extended we require a compensating control (isolation, WAF rule, monitored mitigation) and approve via the VM review board.

Attachments included (links below and attached files):
- vuln-scan-index-2025-05-02.csv (CI-integrated scan index, last authenticated full scan: 2025-05-02)
- cve-commitment-matrix-2025-05-02.xlsx (rows: CVE, severity, owner, triage date, remediation ETA, exception notes)

If the auditors want the control mapping to SOC 2 CC6.x and SIG/CAIQ references, we can append a short mapping sheet. Let me know which format they prefer (inline sheet vs separate PDF).

Monica Patel
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: vuln-scan-index-2025-05-02.csv (CSV, 48KB), cve-commitment-matrix-2025-05-02.xlsx (XLSX, 92KB)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Evan Lee <evan.lee@evercrest.com>, security.audit@evercrest.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 May 2025 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: VM attestation (signed) and final packet — Redwood Inference

Evan —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the confirm. Per your request, attached is Redwood's one-page attestation that describes our VM cadence, triage and remediation SLAs, and the governance around exceptions. The attestation is signed by Ben Carter (VP of Security Operations) and countersigned by Monica Patel (Senior Security Engineer) for technical accuracy.

Key callouts in the attestation (excerpt):
- We confirm weekly unauthenticated scans and monthly full authenticated scans with daily delta checks on critical services.
- Critical CVE triage within 48 hours; target remediation within 7 calendar days unless an exception is recorded in the CVE commitment matrix.
- Exceptions require documented compensating controls and VM review board approval.

Artifacts delivered: vuln-scan-index-2025-05-02.csv; cve-commitment-matrix-2025-05-02.xlsx; vm-attestation-2025-05-05.pdf (signed).

DocuSign: We can also execute the auditor's DocuSign template if you prefer the auditor-provided envelope (reference DOCUSIGN-REQ-7842). If so, send the link and we'll sign through that flow.

Hannah Schmitt
Director, Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference

Attachment: vm-attestation-2025-05-05.pdf (PDF, signed, 8KB)
